sentences.text: Homer Hadley Hickam , Jr. -LRB- born February 19 , 1943 -RRB- is an American author , Vietnam veteran , and a former NASA engineer .	Vietnam	Vietnam War	Vietnam veteran	Vietnam veteran	NASA	NASA

His memoir Rocket Boys was a New York Times Best Seller and is studied in many American and international school systems , and was the basis for the 1999 film October Sky .	memoir	memoir	Rocket Boys	Rocket Boys	October Sky	October Sky
Hickam has also written a number of best-selling memoirs and novels including the `` Josh Thurlow '' historical fiction novels .
His books have been translated into many languages .
